questions.question: Does assembled observable evidence satisfy AC-VM-2: Each allowed Host returns its fixed issuer/resource, metadata challenge and reachable client endpoints; VM authorization advertises canonical /authorize/vm; forwarded headers cannot alter identity.

Does assembled observable evidence satisfy AC-VM-7: Deployment docs and example describe opt-in, unchanged host binding/callback, local HTTP trust, reauthorization, VM client callback forwarding and actual verification commands with truthful pending live results.
Are invalid requests bounded and rejected without exposing credentials?
Are profile validation, transaction binding and HTTP selection owned once through typed seams?
Do behavioral matrices discriminate wrong-profile use and canonical browser composition?
Are Host/Origin/CSRF/PKCE/owner/approval and resource checks preserved for both profiles?
Are local HTTP and live-client limitations documented without claiming deployment success?
